title: Board meeting preparation
text:
Ada: The board meets in two weeks. Let's agree on the deck outline today.
Luis: Start with the quarter's numbers: revenue, burn and runway.
Ada: Then the product update. Shared reports shipped, and the early numbers look good.
Luis: We should be honest about the northern region. They missed their target.
Ada: Agreed. With the reason and the plan to fix it.
Luis: The board will ask about hiring. We planned six roles and filled four.
Ada: I will add a slide on hiring with the two open roles and when we expect to fill them.
Luis: And the fundraising question. Do we raise this year or next?
Ada: Let's present both paths with the runway for each, and ask for their view.
Luis: Who writes which part?
Ada: I will write the product and hiring parts. You take the numbers and the fundraising options.
Luis: Draft by Monday, then we review it together on Wednesday.
Ada: Good. I will send the outline to everyone after this call.
